name: obsidian-mcp-server
description: Read, write, search, and surgically edit Obsidian vault notes, tags, and frontmatter via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

OBSIDIAN_API_KEY.title: Obsidian API key
OBSIDIAN_API_KEY.description: Required. Bearer token for the Obsidian Local REST API plugin (Settings → Community Plugins → Local REST API).

OBSIDIAN_BASE_URL.title: Obsidian base URL
OBSIDIAN_BASE_URL.description: Optional. Base URL of the Local REST API plugin; defaults to http://127.0.0.1:27123. Use https://127.0.0.1:27124 for the HTTPS port.
